metadata.title: Author Archive
metadata.subtitle: A curated collection of interviews, commentaries, afterwords, magazine features, and other historical material from Hitoma Iruma.

articles.title: A Sudden Corner Where I Talk About What I've Been Thinking Regarding My More Recent Characters
articles.summary: Hitoma Iruma reflects on the characters of Adachi to Shimamura -- particularly Shimamura Hōgetsu and Adachi Sakura -- discussing their evolution, their role as protagonists, and the author's personal connection to them after more than a decade of writing.

articles.title: DIARY FROM JUNE 2021
articles.summary: Hitoma Iruma discusses the origin of the character names in Adachi to Shimamura, revealing the inspirations behind Shimamura Hōgetsu, Adachi Sakura, Hino Akira, Nagafuji Taeko, and others.
